comments: Same architecture as kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64_kernel3_finetune_dropout.json (0.3757/0.3635, the standing best) but initialized from kuralsnet_npu_seg_native_kernel3_dropout_short.json's native-resolution kernel3+dropout pretraining checkpoint (val dice 0.4047, epoch 61/150) via a direct full-strict --finetune load -- no partial-transfer needed this time, since the source architecture matches exactly (kernel_size=3, dropout_rate=0.1). Tests whether giving bott_c/d1/d2 real pretrained weights (instead of expand_kernel3.py's random init for those 3 layers) improves on the partial-transfer version's result.
